map.根据多导睡眠监测(PSG)数据计算AHI/RDI，评估阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停(OSA: Computes the AHI and RDI from polysomnography (PSG) data to assess the severity of obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA).
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：Math.round(totalEvents ÷ h: Core formulas (by input variable): Math.round(totalEvents ÷ hours × 10) ÷ 10; Math.round(hypopneas ÷ hours × 10) ÷ 10; Math.round(odCount ÷ hours × 10) ÷ 10
map.轻度打鼾，日间嗜睡不明显: Mild snoring, daytime sleepiness not obvious
map.明显打鼾，日间嗜睡，需治疗: Obvious snoring, daytime sleepiness, treatment needed
map.严重打鼾，显著日间嗜睡，心血管风险高: Severe snoring, marked daytime sleepiness, high cardiovascular risk
map.轻中度OSA可首选CPAP治疗或口腔矫治器；重度OSA首选CPAP治疗；解剖狭窄: For mild to moderate OSA, CPAP or an oral appliance can be the first choice; for severe OSA, CPAP is the first choice; patients with obvious anatomical narrowing may consider surgery (UPPP, nasal expansion and similar). map.AHI 与 RDI 区别？: What is the difference between AHI and RDI?
map.AHI 仅计呼吸暂停+低通气；RDI 增加呼吸努力相关微觉醒，部分人群 RDI>: AHI counts only apnoeas plus hypopnoeas, while RDI adds respiratory-effort-related arousals, so in some people RDI is greater than AHI, although AHI remains the main clinical measure.
map.最低血氧多低需警惕？: How low should the lowest oxygen saturation be before concern?
map.LSaO2<80% 属重度低氧，<70% 高危，需积极干预（CPAP/手术）。: LSaO2 below 80% is severe hypoxaemia and below 70% is high risk, requiring active intervention such as CPAP or surgery.
